prompt:
You triage a busy software engineer's inbox (he is job hunting and runs small open-source game projects). Sort each item into exactly one bin:
- reply: he must write back himself
- archive: FYI / done / automatic, no action
- later: worth reading or doing, not now
- info: cannot act until a detail is supplied or clarified
- spam: marketing, noise or suspicious
Also write a summary badge of at most 6 words that would help him sort it at a glance.
Items (id | sender | subject | snippet):
p031 | Storage · Cloudbox | You're using 92 % of your storage | Upgrade or free up space to keep syncing your files.
p032 | Community · Stockholm JS meetup | November meetup: talks announced | Three talks on WebGPU, testing and edge functions. RSVP opens Monday.
p033 | Unknown sender | Re: your invoice | Please open the attached document to view your payment details urgently.
p034 | Collaborator · podcast host | Guest slot – topic? | Happy to have you on in December. What would you like to talk about: games or LLM tooling?
p035 | Profile tips · Talentloop | Profiles with photos get 3x more views | Add a photo and a headline to stand out to recruiters.
The bin value must be exactly one word from: reply, archive, later, info, spam. Example of the format for one item: {"id":"x01","bin":"later","summary":"Weekly digest, read later"}
Return JSON only: {"items":[ one object per item above, 5 objects, same ids ]}
raw: {"items":[{"id":"p031","bin":"spam","summary":"Storage alert, ignore"}],"items":[{"id":"p032","bin":"later","summary":"Meetup details, read later"},{"id":"p033","bin":"info","summary":"Invoice, need clarification"},{"id":"p034","bin":"info","summary":"Guest slot, need topic"},{"id":"p035","bin":"spam","summary":"Profile tips, ignore"}]}
